target.workspace_source: existing get_workspace_id(current_user); no body workspace field
target.hybrid_columns: entity_types, sync_last_n_days, max_records_per_sync, sync_mode, usage_stats_json are untouched

authority.service: re-reads the current User row, requires active status, freezes status/is_active/raw tenant/effective tenant and claims that exact material in a guarded no-op UPDATE in the decision transaction
authority.zero_match: effect=none refusal; settings/audit rollback; peer state preserved
authority.cross_workspace: the request cannot select another workspace; rows in other workspaces are never read or written

routes.effect: insert a deterministic ingestion_settings row or guarded UPDATE of the supplied seven fields, plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.create: deterministic id ingestion:<HMAC(workspace,integration)> with model defaults and supplied fields; primary-key arbiter handles a concurrent insert
routes.merge: only supplied fields change; unspecified fields and hybrid columns are preserved
routes.no_change: only integration_id or an already-matching request -> 200 effect=none, no audit
routes.cache: existing service cache cleared and reloaded after a committed change; DB row is authority and reload failure does not change the result

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id document-settings:<supplied-or-generated>
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no raw folder paths, file-type lists, secrets, SQL parameters or exception text in the receipt or logs
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session; audit fields and the target settings digest must match

result_states.no_change: only integration_id or already-matching request; 200 effect=none; no audit
result_states.effect_unknown: 503 effect=unknown; original identity; replay=do_not_repeat; no exception text

parallel_writers.AutoDocumentIngestionService.update_sett: retained for internal/test callers; the route no longer calls it
parallel_writers.AutoDocumentIngestionService._persist_se: retained for other callers; the route no longer relies on best-effort persistence
parallel_writers.get_settings/sync/upload: read through the service cache, which is cleared/reloaded after commit

not_covered: live provider, credential, spend, send, download or deployment
